artifact.title: Current-state journey map and service blueprint
artifact.question: What does one Test of Details feel like today, stage by stage, what happens behind the auditor and what changes when agents join?
artifact.iDecided: To map one Test of Details through the Senior's eyes, to put the emotion curve where the deadline bites and to place the mandatory checkpoints where judgment lives.
artifact.weBuilt: The maps in two workshop sessions with the design team and the methodology reviewer role; the backstage rows with the engagement data lead role.

label: Reconstructed from the themes in 03. Emotion values are the lead's reading of the evidence on a five-point scale, not a measurement. Future-state feeling is design intent.
lens: Engagement Senior (Dana Whitlock, P1) running one Test of Details on revenue. Manager and Partner enter at review and sign.

stages.name: Plan
stages.doing: Scope the area. Pick procedures from the methodology. Set sample sizes.
stages.thinking: Which structure fits this client this year?
stages.pain: Structures adapted by hand before work starts (T13).
stages.opportunity: Plan against a typed structure from the library.
stages.front: Senior scopes the area and sets the plan with the manager.
stages.back: Prior-year file pulled by the engagement data lead.

future.auditor: Scopes and chooses structures from the library.
future.agent: Proposes procedures per assertion from prior-year results and risk, with sources.
future.delta: Fit replaces adaptation. Proposals are visibly drafts.

stages.name: Assess risk
stages.doing: Rate assertions by risk with the manager. Set thresholds.
stages.thinking: Where did last year's exceptions come from?
stages.pain: Prior-year context lives in people, not the file (T11).
stages.front: Senior and manager rate risk per assertion.
stages.back: Data lead maps client systems to areas.

future.auditor: Rates risk. Confirms or overrides the agent's proposal.
future.agent: Surfaces prior-year exceptions and resolutions per assertion with citations.
future.delta: Context in the file, not in memory.

stages.name: Design procedures
stages.doing: Pick the Test of Details structure. Define population and sample method.
stages.thinking: Will the reviewer accept this structure?
stages.pain: Local variants cause review notes later (T13, T10).
stages.opportunity: A library with fit rules; no in-place edits.
stages.front: Senior picks the structure and the sample method.
stages.back: Population extract requested from the client.

future.auditor: Picks structure and sample method. Approves the plan.
future.agent: Plans the run against the typed structure and shows the plan: steps, sources, classes it will touch.
future.checkpoint: Plan approval before the run starts.
future.delta: The plan is explicit and reviewable before any work happens.

stages.name: Gather evidence
stages.doing: Raise client requests. Chase. Open three systems to find one document.
stages.thinking: Where is that statement? Is this the right version?
stages.pain: Locating costs more than judging (T1). Data limits known unevenly (T9).
stages.opportunity: Agent retrieval within data classes, with a record of what was read.
stages.front: Senior and associate raise and chase requests, assemble documents.
stages.back: Requests to the client. Confirmations sent through the confirmation service. Bank portal pulls.

future.auditor: Approves restricted-class retrieval. Sees what was read.
future.agent: Retrieves within permitted classes. Logs every source read.
future.delta: Q1 answered in the product. Waiting moves to the agent.

stages.name: Test
stages.doing: Trace each sampled item field by field. Record results.
stages.thinking: Same five fields, item after item.
stages.pain: The repetitive core (T2). Attention fades late. Interruptions restart the trace (T12).
stages.opportunity: Agent extraction and matching. Auditor on the differences.
stages.front: Associate traces samples. Senior clears the hard ones.

future.auditor: Reviews matches by exception. Spot-checks through citation chips.
future.agent: Extracts fields, matches to records, flags differences with the span highlighted.
future.checkpoint: None mandatory. Low confidence routes to needs review.
future.delta: T2 handed off. Provenance on every match.

stages.name: Evaluate exceptions
stages.doing: Investigate differences. Call the client. Document.
stages.thinking: Is this a misstatement or an explanation?
stages.pain: Context assembled by hand before judgment can start (T6).
stages.opportunity: An exception workbench with evidence attached.
stages.front: Senior resolves exceptions with the client. Manager consulted on judgment calls.

future.auditor: Judges each exception. Calls the client. Records the resolution.
future.agent: Documents each exception with the evidence and the difference attached. Never resolves.
future.checkpoint: Mandatory human resolution of every exception.
future.delta: Judgment stays human. Assembly is done.

stages.name: Conclude
stages.pain: Rework originates in references and wording (T4).
stages.opportunity: Draft with references in place. Edits recorded as a diff.

future.auditor: Edits the draft. The diff is recorded.
future.agent: Drafts the conclusion with citations on every claim.
future.checkpoint: Mandatory before a draft becomes the conclusion.
future.delta: References in place. The edit is visible to the reviewer.

stages.name: Review
stages.doing: Wait. Clear notes. Clear them again.
stages.pain: Latency compounds (T5). Reviewer decodes format before substance (T10). Source first (T3).
stages.opportunity: A review center with state and provenance in view.

future.auditor: Manager works the queue. Rejects one step if needed.
future.agent: Reruns the rejected step with the corrected input. Keeps the history.
future.checkpoint: Approve, edit or reject on every run.
future.delta: Queue with state. Source one click away. Notes stop looping.

stages.name: Sign
stages.thinking: Will she ask for the exception trail?
stages.pain: If it is wrong, it is my name (T8). The trail is spread across files and emails.
stages.opportunity: Exception trail and checkpoint record in the file.
stages.front: Partner reviews high-risk areas and signs.

future.auditor: Partner reads the exception trail and the checkpoint record. Signs.
future.agent: Nothing. No write path to sign-off.
future.delta: Q2 and Q4 answered where liability lives.
